ci_support_linux_64_python3.11.____cpyth:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
rust_compiler:
- rust
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: jiter
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: jiter
  version: "0.18.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/jiter-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a0ca63fd9450a212e4e658d4cfe0ab4977c4f9b0003c68828b843c65e27662ff

build:
  number: 0
  skip: python.endswith("t")
  script:
    env:
      PYO3_USE_ABI3_FORWARD_COMPATIBILITY: 1
    content: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - maturin
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - python
    - maturin >=1,<2
    - pip
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - jiter
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: Fast iterable JSON parser.
  license: MIT
  license_file: crates/jiter/LICENSE
  homepage: https://crates.io/crates/jiter

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
